reviews.comment: Amazing Prof. she is very accessible outside of the class and is very caring of all of her students. If you have an issue with anything she will find a way to make things work. One midterm and one Group Paper are the biggest grade factors. She gives a lot of extra credit if you actually go to the lectures. 10/10 would recommend the NOW Dr. Dhima.

Professor Dhima rocks! She truly cares about her students and the subject matter. Attending lecture is extra credit. There is one midterm and one group paper, as well as short writing assignments and quizzes throughout. I highly recommend this class!

I absolutely love her & will be looking for excuses to take another class of hers in the future. Not only is she brilliant, but she is extremely kind & values learning over grades. Very thorough in her explanations & answering questions & is available outside of class, also responds to emails quickly. My favorite prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: lectures were usually drawn-out versions of the readings so i usually relied more heavily on the textbook my classmates who relied more on the lectures said the lectures got better as semester went along newer prof so give her some time to adapt if i were to do it again, i would definitely find a better way to study for the midterms

Professor Dhima is the most caring prof I've ever had! Someone asked if there are test reviews. She said she wasn't planning on it, but she would make them if it would help. She is passionate about the topic and that students really understand the concepts. I loved her lectures, and she sometimes gives extra credit for attending. Highly recommend!

Dhima is super sweet and cares about her students, just isnt the best prof. If you read the book and attend lectures homeworks are an easy A, however exams are a different story. Exams were ridiculously hard and did not accurately reflect her lectures or the hw. Records lectures so class isnt mandatory/ offers extra credit to those who attend.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Dhima is one of most caring and considerate professors I've ever taken! She gave the class several extra credit opportunities and attentively listened to our feedback about her class. Also, her lectures made the coursework interesting and easy to understand!

It's actually Kostanca Dhima, rate my professor kept saying she wasn't teaching anymore, but they're wrong. Anyways it's definitely an easy B, and an A if you work. 3 exams and homework almost weekly. The homework was usually found on quizlet, and if you watched the lectures, test were super easy. She also does extra credit for attending class.

Professor Dhima might actually be a gift from God. She spends time to make sure you understand the material fully, and is always available for questions, and she offers many opportunities for extra credit or to fix homework. The material was somewhat difficult, but she did as much as she could to make sure as many people got an A as possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Dhima is literally the sweetest woman I have ever had the pleasure of learning from. She cares so much about her students, going to great lengths to try and ensure that everyone got the best grade they possibly could. If I could take her for every POLS class I have left until I graduate, I wouldn't even think twice about it. Perfect prof.

My one ding for her is that she is so smart that sometimes I think the content moves a little fast for beginners -- but she always slows down when asked. She seems so enthusiastic about the subject she teaches which makes the class more enjoyable! She does a great job of answering questions and making expectations clear.
